title: 第110章 冰湖骨阵上第109章 韩无极作证
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
“第三炉口未必像前两口这样能反吃。”
周荒低头看着炉图。
三十六个小点中，第三个点正在微微闪烁。
它离旧冰谷不远。
但方向不是北冥主炉。
而是偏向一处冰湖。
屏幕浮现。
【第三炉口：炼骨口。】
【功能：剥骨、炼骨、筛骨髓。】
【状态：苏醒中。】
【提示：此炉已接收第一、第二炉口传回信息。】
周荒眼神沉了沉。
第三炉口已经知道他了。
也就是说，后面的炉会越来越针对他。
第一炉口不知道他会反点名。
第二炉口不知道他的血会让它乱判。
第三炉口，恐怕不会再犯同样的错。
沈青禾看着他的脸色。
“看到了？”
“嗯。”

“第三口？”
“炼骨。”
沈青禾脸色一白。
顾清寒也皱眉。
炼骨二字，听起来就不是好东西。
韩无极忽然开口：
“我知道冰湖。”
众人看向他。
韩无极撑着身体，艰难道：
“我们被带来旧冰谷前，曾经过一片冰湖。”
“湖面下面，有很多骨头。”
“不是尸骨。”
“是洗干净的骨头。”
他声音低了些。
“像被人一根一根挑出来，摆在湖底。”
玄阳宗几名弟子脸色发青。
赤霞宗女修忍不住后退半步。
修仙界死人不稀奇。
可把人的骨头一根根剥出来，洗净，摆在湖底，用来炼炉。
这种事，已经不是邪修两个字能概括。
content_en:
"The third mouthful may not be as repulsive as the first two."
Zhou Huang lowered his head and looked at the furnace diagram.
Among the thirty-six small dots, the third dot is flickering.
It's not far from the Old Ice Valley.
But the direction is not the main furnace of Beiming.
Instead, it leans towards an icy lake.
The screen appears.
[The third furnace mouth: the bone refining mouth. 】
[Function: peeling bones, refining bones, and sieving marrow. 】
[Status: Awakening. 】
[Tip: This furnace has received the information returned from the first and second furnace mouths. 】
Zhou Huang's eyes darkened.
The third furnace already knew him.
In other words, the furnaces behind him will become more and more targeted at him.
First Lukou didn’t know that he would counter-roll the call.
The second furnace didn't know that his blood would make it random.
At the third furnace entrance, I’m afraid I won’t make the same mistake again.
Shen Qinghe looked at his face.
"See?"
"Yeah."
"Third bite?"
"Bone refining."
Shen Qinghe's face turned pale.
Gu Qinghan also frowned.
The word "bone refining" doesn't sound like a good thing.
Han Wuji suddenly spoke:
"I know Ice Lake."
Everyone looked at him.
Han Wuji supported his body and said with difficulty:
"Before we were brought to the Old Ice Valley, we passed through an icy lake."
"Under the lake, there are a lot of bones."
"Not bones."
"It's clean bones."
His voice was lower.
"It's like being picked out one by one and placed at the bottom of the lake."
Several Xuanyang Sect disciples turned blue.
The female cultivator of Chixia Sect couldn't help but take half a step back.
Death is not uncommon in the world of immortality.
The human bones can be peeled off one by one, washed, and placed at the bottom of the lake to be used for making furnaces.
This kind of thing can no longer be summed up by the word "evil cultivator".
